target_customer: Crypto apps and dapps that need deposit and wallet funding flows
problem: Users struggle to fund wallets across chains and exchanges without bridges, swaps and repeated KYC; Glide offers drop-in deposit flows.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription with usage, listed at $99 per month plus custom enterprise

founders.name: Tushar Soni
founders.background_notes: Tech lead on Robinhood Wallet; maintains Copper, a Go web toolkit.

technical_complexity.rationale: Multi-chain routing and exchange integrations with a widget and headless SDK are standard engineering with hard integration parts.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations help but onramp incumbents could build similar flows.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: MoonPay acquired Glide in July 2026 in an all-equity deal to fold it into MoonPay Deposits.

market_need_then: Wallet funding was a known onboarding pain, and the Wyre onramp shutdown in 2023 pushed apps to switch providers; Glide's founders saw it directly while building Robinhood Wallet.

identity.voice_and_tone: Short, direct and confident: Any wallet. Any chain. Any card. One deposit flow.

brand_strength.rationale: Easy name but confusable with Glide Apps and other Glide companies, which show in search results; no press about the brand itself.

outcome_analysis: Glide was a four person YC S23 team of former Robinhood Wallet engineers building crypto deposit flows. It reportedly reached more than 50 business customers and about $100M annualized volume before MoonPay acquired it in July 2026 in an all-equity deal with undisclosed terms. The exit looks like a strategic acquisition for a capability rather than a venture-scale outcome, and only a roughly $500K YC-stage round is documented.
notes: Funding: CB Insights says a $0.5M convertible note dated 2023-01, VCBacked says $500K pre-seed in Sept 2023, YC as sole investor; both are aggregators, so the round is unverified by a primary source. Deal terms undisclosed. Competitor search returned only 2026 comparison pages, so the list is empty.
